title: Duplicate Claim � Different Claimant, Same Passenger Already Compensated
goal: A different person (e.g., travel agent, spouse) files a claim for a passenger who was already compensated on a previous claim filed by the passenger themselves. System detects that the PASSENGER has already been compensated even though the CLAIMANT is different. Validates that duplicate detection is passenger-based, not claimant-based.

checkpoints.step: A different person (e.g., travel agent, spouse) files a claim for a passenger who was already compensated on a previous claim filed by the passenger themselves. System detects that the PASSENGER has already been compensated even though the CLAIMANT is different. Validates that duplicate detection is passenger-based, not claimant-based.
